seam: apps/web/app/live-mission/data-seam.ts:getLiveMissionData -> apps/web/live-data/src/producer.ts:createLiveMissionDataProducer (composed ONCE at module scope) -> apps/web/live-data/src/data-plane.ts:runLiveDataPlane (ONE bounded honest pass per call)
note_on_repo_head: the matrix is semantic (the field->source binding), not a run artifact; the RUN artifacts are real-data-plane.json / journey-steps.json bound to their producing heads

fields.source: the durable-store selection (runLiveDataPlane step 2): REAL probes of the canonical Neon adapter and the coordination-only Upstash adapter behind the frozen P17-A adapters
fields.production: neon:postgres:<databaseName>@<branchName> — ONLY when the canonical store answered a real probe (selection.mode === PRODUCTION_DURABLE, canonical.state === CONNECTED)
fields.reference: reference:in-memory-observation-store — the EXPLICIT reference marker whenever the canonical store is any honest state other than CONNECTED (UNKNOWN / UNAVAILABLE / DEGRADED). Reference state NEVER masquerades as production durable state; the marker is machine-checkable in the data-plane view (store.reference_mode) and the selection note

fields.source: the pass clock at the selection/projection instant (the app's impure time boundary: the real system clock via the producer defaults; injectable in the deterministic suites)
fields.production: the real current RFC3339 instant of the pass
fields.reference: the real current RFC3339 instant of the pass (identical semantics — time is never fabricated on either side)

fields.source: the observation plane's drain report (runLiveDataPlane step 5 — createRealObservationPlane.drain, WITHOUT a body)
fields.production: the drain instant when the observation environment is complete (GITHUB_ACCESS_TOKEN present)
fields.reference: null on the honest unwired path (no observation config -> NO drain ran -> drainedAt stays null; the surface renders 'No live observation drain has run yet')

fields.source: the plane's connectivity snapshot (every §5 family: github / ci / deployment / telemetry / provider-health / scheduled-probe), each state derived from REAL probes only
fields.production: CONNECTED / DEGRADED / UNAVAILABLE per real probe outcomes with the real transport facts and api revisions
fields.reference: UNKNOWN when never probed (a state not probed this run is UNKNOWN — 'UNKNOWN is not health'); [] when the observation env is incomplete

fields.source: the drain report's applied events total (sourceSummaries)
fields.production: the real count of observation events applied in the freshness window

fields.source: the GitHub REST events observation (the P17-C plane's repository snapshot family)
fields.production: the real branch heads (e.g. main@<sha>), open pull requests, and the freshness verdict within the window
fields.reference: empty / NO_DATA when no GitHub observation ran

fields.source: the GitHub Actions CI observation (the plane's ci family)
fields.production: the real latest run per pipeline with its capture-level status carried verbatim (SUCCESS / FAILURE / IN_PROGRESS — never folded)
fields.reference: empty / NO_DATA when no CI observation ran

fields.source: the Vercel deployment-events observation (the plane's deployment family) + the real Vercel deployment-state read (runLiveDataPlane step 3 — /v6/deployments with the EXACT source_revision_sha)
fields.production: the real deployed revision per environment with since-instants; the deployment/source-SHA binding verdict (VERIFIED / DIVERGED / NO_DEPLOYMENT / UNAVAILABLE) is projected in the data-plane view
fields.reference: empty / NO_DATA when no Vercel observation ran; the deployment read state is UNKNOWN with the reason when no VERCEL_TOKEN exists

fields.source: the plane's provider-health family (real probes of every provider)
the reconciliation (the claims port — the production deployment claim from the REAL Vercel read + the durable previous-snapshot claim from the canonical store — reconciled against the observed state)
fields.production: ALIGNED / DIVERGED / UNVERIFIED / STALE with the evidence event ids; the durable claim exists only when the canonical store is CONNECTED

fields.source: the plane's detections (e.g. CI_FAILING_ON_HEAD — carried verbatim, never folded into a finding)
fields.production: the real detections of the pass

fields.source: the §5 rule: the observation plane runs WITHOUT a body — observation never depends on a body lease
fields.production: true (the live mission observation is body-independent by construction)
fields.reference: true (identical semantics — the honest empty state also watches without a body)

never_fabricated: an incomplete observation environment returns the honest empty state (UNKNOWN/NO_DATA + missingEnv on the data-plane result) — never a synthetic snapshot
Neon/Upstash unreachability degrades to the explicit reference-store marker with the real transport fact carried verbatim — reference state never masquerades as production durable state
in reference mode NOTHING is persisted (the durability record states persisted:false with the reason; machine-checkable)
a state not probed this run is UNKNOWN (never health); a failed provider is UNAVAILABLE with the real reason
